'''Silas''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
After [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces took control over the [[Corellian Security Force Academy]] in [[Axial Park]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]], Silas and the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] were recruited by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to attack and reclaim the academy. They got inside, but the Imperials pinned Silas and his men down, with [[Davit]] near death and [[Hanley]] and [[Crissom]] not much better. Silas tried to contact reinforcements at Checkpoint Lambda, but those were overrun as well, and a Republic hero answered the call instead. Responding to Silas' plea for help, the hero stormed the CorSec Academy building and rescued him and the rest of his squad before they were overrun by the Empire.
